title: Single-phase dwelling services and feeders (83% rule table)
edition: NFPA 70-2023 Table 310.12 (labeled Table 310.12(A) in the 2026 draft; values unchanged by any First Revision)

source.document: CMP-6 First Draft final ballot results, A2025 (FR-7943/7953/8031)

rules_seen: 310.12(A) services: conductor ampacity permitted to be not less than 83 percent of the service rating.
310.12(B) feeders: not less than 83 percent of the feeder rating (dwelling main power feeder).
Where 310.15(B)/(C) correction or adjustment applies, it applies (relocated from former (D) in the 2026 draft).
notes: Applies to 120/240 V single-phase dwelling services and the main power feeder; a subpanel feeder that is not the main power feeder uses 310.16.

Re-checked 2026-10-20: 11/11 rows match NFPA's 2026 First Draft (FR-7943, labelled 'Table 310.12(A)'), the North Carolina State Fire Marshal's reproduction of the 2011 dwelling table, and a 2020 exam-prep reproduction. Scope: 120/240 V single-phase services and main power feeders of a one-family dwelling or an individual dwelling unit, 100–400 A.
